stem: A dry-room trend shows repeated overnight RH excursions only when racks are fully loaded. Equipment alarms are absent, and lightly loaded nights remain stable. What is the best technician handoff?
choices: Report the loading-dependent pattern, affected dates/lots, room trends, and absence of alarms so capacity/airflow/equipment performance can be evaluated
Reduce every future harvest without authorization
Delete lightly loaded nights from the trend
rationale: The repeated relationship between load and conditions is useful evidence, but Technician I should document and escalate rather than assign a final cause or redesign capacity.
